description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_AI홍수예측_학습자료정보 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. AI 강우추적 학습데이터 생성과 관리를 위한 데이터 항목으로, RainNet, TARM, PySTEPS 등 AI 모델 학습에 필요한 파일들의 목록을 텍스트 파일 형태로 저장한다. 저장된 파일 목록은 MLOps 환경에서 AI 학습 과정에 바로 활용될 수 있도록 제공되며, 이를 통해 학습 데이터 관리와 추적... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 댐방류량, 학습입력자료, 수위, 강우, 3시간누적강우. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
